card.name: Words just before 'the' in all-caps text
card.fires_on: The word right before an expected 'the', mostly in ALL-CAPS warning text (e.g. 'WHETHER', 'AND', 'ING', 'TO'). Also hyphenated name glosses like 'Village-in-Thick-Timber'.

modes.label: All-caps warnings
modes.description: Verb, conjunction or preposition in capitalized label text, where 'THE' comes next.
modes.example: CAREFUL INQUIRY SHOULD BE MADE TO DETERMINE<< WHETHER>> THE PATIENT HAS HAD PREVIOUS

modes.label: Hyphenated name glosses
modes.description: The 'in' inside translated place or name labels, followed by a hyphen and a word.

card.writes: It promotes 'the' in several forms, including capitalized and hyphen-joined ones.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before an upcoming 'the', mostly in capitalized warning text.
